steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The portfolio is worth as much as the performance — it must be detailed, reflective and analytical. | Key Fact: Document EVERY stage: stimulus response, research, exploration, rehearsal, refinement, performance. | Key Fact: Reflection: not just what you did, but WHY you did it and what you would change — show critical thinking. | Key Fact: Practitioner influence: explicitly show how Stanislavski, Brecht, Frantic Assembly etc. shaped your work.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What should you include in a devising portfolio to achieve a high mark? | Explain the difference between describing what you did and evaluating why you did it. Why is evaluation more important? | How would you document the influence of a practitioner on your devised piece?

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
